verdicts.reason: The two candidates look pixel-identical. In both, the headline is pushed tight against the top and left edges, and 'FESTIVAL' wraps onto its own third line, which weakens the original's two-line lockup. The photo crop also loses the white chairs and the staircase, so the image is mostly blank wall. The blue and black info boxes are bunched on the right with uneven margins and leave the lower-left quarter empty. The text is readable and the brand colours survive, but the layout needs a designer's fixes before it ships.
